content: 🧩 # Gladly MCP by usefulapi Find customers, read conversations, items and tasks; add internal notes in Gladly. Gladly MCP by usefulapi runs hosted, so there is nothing to install on your machine. The command below adds it to Claude Code, and the setup below adds it to Claude Desktop as a custom connector and connects Cursor and VS Code straight to the hosted endpoint. APIProductivity ## Install `claude mcp add --transport http gladly-mcp-by-usefulapi https://gladly.usefulapi.io/mcp` ## Hosted server `https://gladly.usefulapi.io/mcp` This server runs hosted, so there is no local process to install. The command above adds it to Claude Code. Claude Desktop adds it as a custom connector under Settings > Connectors, and the client configs below connect Cursor and VS Code straight to the hosted endpoint. Any sign-in the server needs happens when you first connect. ## Install with your client Terminal ``` claude mcp add --transport http gladly-mcp-by-usefulapi https://gladly.usefulapi.io/mcp ``` Run this in a terminal to add the server to Claude Code. ## What this does Gladly MCP by usefulapi exposes a set of tools to Claude over the Model Context Protocol. It runs as a hosted server, so once you add it with the command above, those tools become callable inside any conversation, with nothing running on your machine. ## Frequently asked questions ### How do I install Gladly MCP by usefulapi? Gladly MCP by usefulapi runs hosted, so there is nothing to install locally. The command on this page adds it to Claude Code. Claude Desktop adds it as a custom connector under Settings > Connectors, and the Cursor and VS Code configs on this page connect straight to the hosted endpoint at https://gladly.usefulapi.io/mcp. ### Which clients work with Gladly MCP by usefulapi? This page carries setup and config for Claude Code, Claude Desktop, Cursor and VS Code. Any other MCP client that accepts a standard server config can connect to Gladly MCP by usefulapi as well. ### Does Gladly MCP by usefulapi need an API key? This listing does not ask for an API key or any environment variables. Imported from the Official MCP Registry.
